 LIHEAP application period underway 
 By ssebby@spencerdailyreporter.com 
 on 
 November 05, 2026 
 Assistance with heating bills through the federal Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program is available to help qualifying Iowa households pay part of their residential heating costs.
